correctness.rationale: The two bases and 2n triangular lateral facets of the twisted convex hull have explicit normals (e_{(j+1/2)theta},c) and (e_{(j+1/2)theta+t},-c), c>0 for twist in (0,theta). Vertex-base active inequalities require z<0 at top vertices and z>0 at bottom, so a direction cannot mix layers. A per-layer maximum m=floor(n/2) follows from antipodal lower normals for even n, and a single Hamiltonian odd-cycle conflict of opposite combined normals for odd n. The explicit block direction u=(-e_beta,-w/c), with U<w<C, strictly illuminates each m-consecutive block. Cyclic block covering and sum of fractional vertex constraints then prove I=2ceil(n/m), I*=2n/m. For aligned t=0 Cartesian prism, the planar illuminated block capacity becomes q=floor((n-1)/2), establishing separate discontinuous endpoint formulas. Independently evaluated 450 strict block-facet witness sets for n<=17; finite checks corroborate, not prove, all real t and all n.
